speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I am Dr. Agent; please tell me, when did your fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise begin?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detail; could you please confirm if the ice cream was left out at room temperature or if there was a history of listeriosis in your community or social circle? Also, have you experienced any muscle aches or sensitivity to light since the symptoms began?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The patient mentions consuming ice cream three days prior to symptom onset, which raises suspicion for *Listeria monocytogenes*. Have you noticed any specific neurological changes like confusion, stiff neck, or visual disturbances, or any abdominal pain? Additionally, has your pregnancy resulted in any complications such as fluid leakage or contractions?

REQUEST TEST: CBC, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, and Blood Cultures
REQUEST IMAGES: Lumbar_Puncture_Results (if indicated by mental status changes)

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: CBC: WBC 15,000 /μL (elevated), Hemoglobin 12.5 g/dL, Platelets 200,000 /μL; Comprehensive Metabolic Panel: AST Within normal limits, ALT Within normal limits, Bilirubin Within normal limits; Blood Cultures: Gram-positive rods that are catalase-positive and show distinctive tumbling motility in the liquid medium.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Unremarkable. The patient is currently pregnant, at her 30th week of gestation. Social history: Non-smoker, does not consume alcohol. No recent travels or contact with sick individuals. No known allergies.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies cough, shortness of breath, abdominal pain, diarrhea, or urinary symptoms. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Iron deficiency anemia and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That previous suggestion of iron deficiency anemia does not explain your sudden high fever or malaise; those are signs of infection. Since you have been pregnant, did your headache become severe or accompanied by visual changes like blurred vision or seeing spots?

REQUEST TEST: CBC, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, and Blood Cultures
REQUEST IMAGES: Lumbar_Puncture_Results (if indicated by mental status changes)

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: CBC: WBC 15,000 /μL (elevated), Hemoglobin 12.5 g/dL, Platelets 200,000 /μL; Comprehensive Metabolic Panel: AST Within normal limits, ALT Within normal limits, Bilirubin Within normal limits; Blood Cultures: Gram-positive rods that are catalase-positive and show distinctive tumbling motility in the liquid medium.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (*Listeria monocytogenes* infection).

The blood culture results showing Gram-positive rods with tumbling motility are pathognomonic for *Listeria*, confirming the suspicion raised by your history of consuming unpasteurized or improperly stored dairy products during pregnancy.
